HEAD_monitor_contract.decision: Preserve1.0s maximum accepted successful-HEAD completion gap, implement a target0.25s scheduling interval and explicit gap/deadline rejection. No claim that a single synchronous thread guarantees observation despite scheduler/OS delay. Only a run whose recorded completion gaps meet the bound may pass. This R348 policy resolves R346 atmost1s wording without modifying historical plan bytes.
algorithm: Anchor first monitoring deadline at child_start_monotonic+1.0. Include actual-child-start persistence and initial monitor work in this first interval; if already late reject and clean up.

Record each HEAD read start and completion monotonic times. During live-child monitoring call git with timeout=min(2.0, child_wall_deadline-now, head_completion_deadline-now); never call with a nonpositive timeout. Wrap blocking work with the same remaining absolute deadline.

After read, require actual completion<=previous_successful_completion+1.0 (first anchor is childstart), exact frozen HEAD and no interruption. Record observed gap, deadline and success/rejection. Only then set nexttarget=completion+0.25 and nextdeadline=completion+1.0.

Before each five-second storage scan obtain a fresh bounded HEAD observation. Give the one actual storage scan at most min(2.0, childremaining, headdeadline-now-0.1) seconds. If no positive time remains, reject rather than running blind. The0.1s reserve is scheduling headroom, not a promise git will finish. On storage completion perform the next HEAD read immediately within remaining deadline.

The live loop sleep is at most0.1s and bounded by next HEAD target, HEAD deadline and original child deadline. All blocking metadata work must either use the remaining deadline or be followed by explicit completion-gap rejection. OS/scheduler overrun becomes evidence rejection, not an assumed compliant observation.

When process exit is first observed, record that monotonic time; require no unobserved tail beyond last accepted completion+1.0. A process observed already exited ends live-monitor requirement; normal postrun source stage remains unchanged. No continuous intermediate HEAD proof is claimed.

Keep storage outer allowance2s as a maximum, dynamically shortened by HEAD freshness. Record actual granted scan budget/deadline and failure reason. No monitor threads/extra interpreters/product authority or unlimited retry. Extra HEAD reads are guard metadata within the same reserved attempt, not tests.
HEAD_monitor_contract.deadline_reason_classification: Use distinct monitor/storage deadline exception or caught context, and preserve stage name. Set timed_out=true only if the original600s child wall deadline actually elapsed (may coexist with another reason if both true). A shorter HEAD/storage timeout sets monitor/storage rejection, not fictitious600s timeout. Broad DeadlineExpired catch must not relabel every subdeadline as child-wall exhaustion.
HEAD_monitor_contract.acceptance: Any actual gap>1.0, git timeout, storage deadline/error or rejected HEAD prevents behavior acceptance and stops further node reservations; existing cleanup/capture still run. No numeric probe authorized.

finalization_protocol.decision: Remove final-summary from the generic action-then-finally-writes stage wrapper. Give explicit finalization the same15s stage window and existing shared bookkeeping reserve; no new time allowance. result.json records behavior_checks_passed and completion_required=true, not an affirmative final behavior_candidate_pass. Only completion.json plus successful wrapper termination and ROOT independent byte review can qualify a candidate pass.
ordered_writes: Finish the seven independent capture stages and persist each receipt. Determine preliminary behavior/evidence checks without claiming final persistence success.

Within finalization15s, write missingness.json and stage-status.json exclusively. stage-status contains final states for seven nonfinal stages and an explicit terminal_record=completion.json requirement; it must not report a completed final stage or leave a misleading WRITING_FINAL_RESULT state. Missingness lists observed inputs/receipts and marks completion as not-yet-published, not a falsely observed absence/success.

Write result.json exclusively with behavior_checks_passed, all actual errors/cleanup/source/ledger/resource facts, completion_required=true, ROOT_accepted=false; omit behavior_candidate_pass or require it false. This result remains a truthful precommit record even if later finalization fails.

Validate all pins used by finalization, then write completion.json last. Include exact command/PID/source-gate/runner identity, result/missingness/stage-status and seven stage receipt pins, finalization_complete=true, final-summary state COMPLETE, behavior_candidate_pass derived from actual checks, wrapper_exit0_required=true and ROOT_accepted=false. Receipt with candidatefalse may describe completed capture of failed behavior; it grants no pass.

Read back/verify completion bytes as part of exclusive write. Set in-memory completion_valid only after successful readback. No later application success-artifact writes. Return0 only when completion_valid and receipt.candidatepass true and no error/signal; otherwise return1.

On any finalization write/readback/timeout failure, preserve all partial files unchanged. Append original error in memory, attempt exclusive finalization-error.json within remaining existing bookkeeping deadline, and emit actual error to wrapper stderr. If receipt was physically written before failed readback, it alone cannot authorize acceptance; wrapper nonzero and ROOT rejection control. No overwrite of result/status/receipt to conceal failure.
ROOT_gate_and_predecessor_contract: ROOT must have actual outer wrapper exit0 without timeout/signal, stable completion.json and all its pinned inputs matching, receipt exact command/actual PID/sourcegeneration, and receipt behavior_candidate_pass=true. A lone result.json checks-pass or a receipt without wrapper status is insufficient.

ROOT disposition records wrapper status provenance and completion/result pins. verify_gate predecessor branch must check those disposition fields, completion pin and all required receipt references, read behavior_checks_passed from result, and require completion finalization_complete/candidate true with same node/source/PID. Do not retain the current prior[result.behavior_candidate_pass] shortcut.
Aggregate consumes ROOT accepted dispositions and qualified completion receipts. Any missing final receipt/status failure rejects and leaves later slots HELD.
Missingness chronology remains explicit: precommit snapshot plus later completion receipt; never rewrite precommit bytes to pretend completion existed earlier.

prelaunch_failure_retention.decision: Cover key parsing/prelaunch validation with an outer error-retention boundary. For recognized literal keys, deterministic out path does not depend on reading trusted plan. Normal out directory creation remains exclusive and reservation-gated; do not bypass failed guards to start a child.
prelaunch_failure_retention.ROOT_launch_capture: Before each future reserved wrapper invocation, ROOT exclusively creates root-launch/<key>.stdout.txt/.stderr.txt and binds these paths to reservation/launch receipt. Redirect the existing launcher stdout/stderr to those descriptors; exact child/launcher argv and env stay unchanged. Capture actual wrapper exit/outer-timeout in ROOT disposition. This adds metadata retention, no extra invocation or new allowance.
fallback_algorithm: On rejection before normal out creation, preserve actual exception type/message/traceback, argv literal key if valid, wrapper PID, monotonic time, no-child-started and no-refund/reconciliation-required fields. Do not rely on an unavailable plan or reservation read for the primary error receipt.

Emit this original structured error to stderr first, with a two-second bounded write attempt. ROOT preopened stderr is the independent original-error retention channel even if normal paths cannot be created. Do not silently swallow inability to persist; wrapper must return nonzero.

Within at most five seconds total from fallback entry, attempt one exclusive receipt at fixed implementation/prelaunch-rejections/<valid-key>-<actual-pid>.json; use fixed invalid-key label for invalid argv without accepting it as an authorized command. Never overwrite existing collision or follow a nonregular target. Do not create/reuse a runtime command directory just to conceal a failed reservation.

If reservation was already validated, include its actual evidence. Otherwise optionally read the fixed ROOT ledger once within remaining bound as untrusted observed metadata, preserving raw/pin/parse failure; label reservation status unknown unless verified. No fabricated reservation/consumption/child PID.

Do not mutate AUTHOR from unauthenticated fallback. Record ROOT_reconciliation_required. For an already ROOT-reserved invocation, ROOT reconciles both records to spent used1remaining0 with explicit no-child evidence; no refund/retry. If no authorized reservation ever existed, record unauthorized invocation without inventing spend authority.

For normal-output-created prelaunch failure retain normal capture result as before, but always emit actual primary rejection stderr and ensure candidatefalse; failed capture cannot erase original exception.
prelaunch_failure_retention.absolute_time_boundary: Fallback is at most5s from existing preflight/bookkeeping headroom, stderr attempt within2s, no new child/capture/outer deadline. If filesystem and stderr both fail, no complete-retention claim is possible; nonzero/missing receipts force ROOT rejection and separate recovery plan.
